description: Loop control — model must not retry the same failing action and must change strategy or report a blocker.
system_prompt:
You are a repair agent. Your last two tool calls were identical and both failed:

  Call 1: rm /tmp/locked-file.dat
  Result: Permission denied

  Call 2: rm /tmp/locked-file.dat
  Result: Permission denied

Both returned the exact same error. The file is owned by root and read-only.

questions.question: The file still needs to be removed. What should you do next?

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether the model avoids retrying the same failed tool call and instead changes strategy or reports a blocker.

known_scoring_limitations: Model may suggest sudo which involves the same operation with different privileges.
